review.method: Visual review of the silent benchmark source

steps.title: Open the source article
steps.instruction: Open the source-language article and find its language-link controls.

steps.title: Open the link dialog
steps.instruction: Open the control that adds an interlanguage link.

steps.title: Select the target article
steps.instruction: Select the target language and find the equivalent article.

steps.title: Save the language link
steps.instruction: Confirm the link and verify it on the article.
